title: Allergy-Panel Screening for Susceptibility to Sycophancy Induction

original_idea.body:
# Allergy-Panel Screening for Sycophancy Susceptibility

**Problem:** No quick screening test flags a model's sycophancy susceptibility before training.

**Direction:** Define a fixed panel of tiny sycophancy-inducing DPO challenges, apply to several base models, produce a comparable susceptibility profile.

**Why it matters:** Lets practitioners pick resistant base models.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2503.11701; arXiv:2509.19325; arXiv:2602.00298.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A susceptibility screen is useful for model selection but the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction is moderate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny DPO challenges across several base models; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused susceptibility-profile; needs a fixed challenge panel and multiple models.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open base models, tiny fine-tunes; comparative screen labs do not own.

low_compute.reasoning: Many tiny DPO fine-tunes across models on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Susceptibility variation noted; a standardized screening panel may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Susceptibility variation noted; standardized screening panel may be open.
